full_page.content:
1925, January
FR. SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. 1
Page 20 Cont.
Jan. 8 Patrick Durkin 38 of 3390 Fort St. Unable to work or keep job six months, reports now able holding job O.K.
15 Restored to Normality - Wm Burkard 57 - 392 Philip Ave. Scrupulous & nerveous 3 months in the Asylum - away from confession over a year, Enrolled To-day perpetually a canundrum to many doctors.
21 20 Yrs. From Confession - Anthony Kollek 49 - Walton Boul. away from confession 20 yrs. reported on Febr. 8th as having been to confession & Communion last week. Deo Gratias
24th George Auger - Anker Hospital, St. Paul Minn. reported To-day by sweet H. as given 48 hours to live yesterday. (Said S.W. A.Ober- man Herbert 4258), Enrolled perpetually To-day Inside of week writes
27th Family Reconciled. Thanks be to God! Thanks to Seraphic Mass Asso- ciation! Mr. & Mrs. McK. Estranged since last July and separated to the sorrow of etc. of child & friends - having enrolled themselves and each other, meet in the Monastery as promoters of same S.M.A. - and shake hands and kiss, weeping in reconciliation. Thanks be to God! Deo Gr.
July 11, 1932 This sad case, as it turned again to be shortly after note above was made, was drawn out a year and 6 mo. away then re- concisled and child given ( after other break) to father: brought to court. To-night reported earnestly gone to confession, anointed, wants to see Fr. Sol.
28 Deafness Mrs Ella Man - 42, 2612 St. Clare Detroit densly deaf for 5 years Husband away - is enrolled yesterday by Catholic Schoefer - she herself Methodist.
Feb. 3rd Sleeping Sickness. Mrs. Mary Sullivan 50 of 2153 Waterloo St. a ca- nunderum to doctors not able to work since June, believed to have a form of sleeping sickness and paralisis - enrolled To-day for two years.
4th John V. Slyker 9 yrs 52 Oakdale Boulivard Pleasant Ridge, enrolled last Monday a puzzle to doctors sees double with one eye and blind in other. reported as seeing better, actually reading the signs - before reaching home Thanks be to God, now wants to be a priest
8th Confession Within Week - After 40 Years. Joseph Votruba 82 yrs 5685 Lonyo Boulivard ailing 3 yrs. not to confession for more than 40 years, was enrolled during Octave Bec 9th of Imm. Conception. On the Octave itself asks for priest, receives everything and till death a-week-later Feast of Epiphany edifies all about
